summary: Variants should make selection narrower, policy clearer and effectiveness measurable.

items.text: Place enrichment behind an intake classifier that emits task class, confidence and required clarifications before selecting blocks.
Render each selected block as a typed section with source, trust level, version and removal control.
Treat every block as versioned prompt text and compare outcome metrics across versions before promotion.
Allocate a per-category token budget and skip enrichment entirely below a measured usefulness threshold.
Keep selected context in the data lane with explicit origin and trust; enrichment may add relevant material but must not grant it instructional authority.
